command:
mkdir -p sui-ownership
cd sui-ownership

mkdir -p .tools/bin move/sources client evidence

curl -fL https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/testnet-v1.83.0/sui-testnet-v1.83.0-macos-arm64.tgz -o .tools/sui.tgz
tar -xzf .tools/sui.tgz -C .tools/bin ./sui
export PATH="$PWD/.tools/bin:$PATH"

sui --version
output: sui 1.83.0-16d2dc1e05ed

command:
sui client --yes new-address ed25519 alice
sui client new-address ed25519 bob

sui client switch --env testnet --address alice
ALICE=$(sui client active-address)

sui client switch --address bob
BOB=$(sui client active-address)

sui client switch --address alice
printf 'ALICE=%s\nBOB=%s\n' "$ALICE" "$BOB"

sui client faucet --address "$ALICE" --url https://faucet.testnet.sui.io

sui client faucet --address "$BOB" --url https://faucet.testnet.sui.io
